conflicts.text: The final context matrix is supposed to preserve the "D_out" dimension, so the number of heads and the head dimension must be merged back together.
conflicts.reason: The reference notes two implementations: the Wrapper concatenates heads to get d_out*num_heads, but the MultiHeadAttention class sets the final output dimension to d_out regardless of num_heads. So it is not generally true that the final context matrix must merge heads back together to preserve a fixed D_out.
